scenes: Hanoi. A fast-growing capital whose power and water strain together in the heat.
In 2023, heat and low reservoirs led to blackouts costing about one point four billion dollars.
The Red Cross tested early action, triggered by a heat forecast.
Plan cooling, power and water together.
